v1.title: The Library Above the Clouds
v1.synopsis: Above the cloud line floats a library that lends books to the weather. Its newest apprentice has a week to find a storm that was never returned.

v1.title: Stardust Wayfarer
v1.synopsis: A lamplighter with no memory of her home walks the old star roads, relighting the beacons that guide travellers between the towns. Each town she saves remembers a little of her, and she, a little less of herself.

rows.title: The Lantern Road
rows.description: A lamplighter wakes on the star road with a lantern and no name.
